shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat, ledger-aware island logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (sky-view only).
- Selection survives column view switches. Pocket maps: celestial/climate via GROUND map; fog-mesh self-heal on first view. Underground biome trial notes in pass 16.
- All levels are real maps. Viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop.
- Logistics doctrine: storage priority wins; consumers fetch back per need; demand hauls residual-clamped + ledger-aware; ALL carried-cargo continuations target the LANDED thing (merge-safe).

## REMOVED FEATURES (postmortems preserved)
**SKYLIGHTS (round 7)** — postmortem pass 16. **MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (round 12)** — removed per user; revisit dossier: 1.6 water facts (riverFlowMap per-variant optional, riverGraph never scribed; wide rivers = IsRiver core + still fringe; width>20 strips roof), three-signal detection (thick-roof tunnel / canyon flanks / mountain-closeness) all implemented at removal, per-FACE hydrology spec (upstream apron, downstream lift + falls, full-body seal), working machinery (ExecuteLift, per-stretch verdicts, BFS apron, force-lift tool); UNSOLVED: per-stretch single-exit-face lip resolution + braided-terrain seal. Lessons in lore (biomes).

## VERIFIED
RMB cross-level (USER) · basement (USER) · Batch A (USER) · bug-wave fixes "mostly fixed" (USER): mech charge crash gone, bill supply + mech RMB working.

## RECENT FIX HISTORY (passes 23-25)
- Pass 23: `Invoke(null)` on instance ShouldAutoRecharge → Logistics guard tripped per session (explained 3 of 5 bug-wave reports). Fixed + demand fan-cap fix + forbidden-aware availability + mech RMB orders. Horax spam ruled not-ours; "incompatible group 1" = per-map name collision.
- Pass 24: ferry discipline — in-flight ledger (self-validating claims, acting-pawn excluded), residual count clamps, onward demand hop (came-from guard).
- Pass 25: merge-kill fix (arrival continuations target the LANDED thing; mech haulers included) + bill-product cross-level continuation (crafter carries product to other-level storage personally). Lore saved (jobs-ai, harmony).

# VANILLA PARITY SCAFFOLD (2026-07-25 deep scan — the build list toward seamless 1:1)

## Audit baseline: what ALREADY exists (do not rebuild)
- **Work migration core**: idle migration (virtual scan of linked levels w/ vanilla givers, 1200-tick cooldown), priority-aware better-work probes (rank-truncated, versioned cooldowns, per-tick budget, island-aware), LevelWorkSummary plausibility cache (fail-open for unknown worktypes → modded/vanilla givers all covered), emergency virtual scans, robot probe variant.
- **Hauling**: full ferry stack (storage push/pull, demand registry incl. bills/surgery/meals/babies/refuel/transporters/blueprints/relay, fetch giver, construction supply + direct-to-blueprint, urgent, bulk/PUAH, ledger + clamps + onward hop + merge-safe arrivals + bill-product continuation).
- **Needs**: rest (owned bed any level, free-bed hop), food (colonists + pets w/ scribed returns), joy, meditation, gear, medical (rescue/capture, med + meal supply), gatherings, rituals, pens + take-to-pen, drugs NOT covered (see P2).
- **Systems**: areas (column semantics), resource counter, wealth, IsPlayerHome (alert/questgen scoped), psychic bonds, colonist bar, trade, caravans, power/pipe links, weather/climate, threats divert suite, mech charge/escort/command/RMB, animal ambient + pet follow.

## P0 — UI TRUTH (vanilla players read these as "mod is broken"; all are small scoped patches)
1. **Bill-add skill dialog** (the reported bug): `ITab_Bills` add-bill check enumerates `SelTable.Map.mapPawns.FreeColonists` → pops `Bill.CreateNoPawnsWithSkillDialog` when the crafters live on another level. Patch: column-wide FreeColonists in that Any(). Same fix in `HealthCardUtility` (surgery recipe list, line ~420).
2. **Bill pawn-restriction dropdown**: audit `BillDialogUtility.GetPawnRestrictionOptionsForBill` — if map-scoped, cross-level crafters can't be assigned to a bill; make column-wide.
3. **Building-existence alerts on the ground map**: Alert_NeedMealSource, Alert_NeedResearchBench, Alert_NeedJoySources, Alert_NeedDefenses (+ audit Alert_JoyBuildingNoChairs) read `map.listerBuildings` per map → false nags when the stove/bench lives on another level. Patch: column-union building existence for the GROUND map's alert evaluation (levels already suppressed via AlertsReadout scope).
4. **Alert_FireInHomeArea + fire visibility audit**: verify a basement fire still alerts (levels are non-home inside AlertsReadout — risk: fully silent fire). Likely needs: fire on any column level surfaces the ground map's alert.
5. **Idle-colonist alert audit** (Alert_ColonistsIdle): confirm it doesn't false-positive when all real work is on another level mid-cooldown; low priority, observe first.

## P1 — EMERGENCY RESPONSIVENESS (idle-migration cadence is too slow for these; wire into the existing emergency scan)
6. **Tend/doctor pull**: patient (colonist/prisoner/downed guest) needs tending on level X, capable doctor on level Y → emergency-scan trigger (currently only rescue-shaped emergencies). Include surgery-ready (bill + ingredients local) as a pull for the surgeon.
7. **Firefighting**: home-area fire on a linked level pulls firefighters NOW (priority-0 parity; pairs with #4).
8. **Feed-patient/warden-feed pull**: hungry fed-unable patient/prisoner with food ON their level but no capable feeder there → pull a feeder (meal ferry half already exists).
9. **Flick cadence**: designated flick (switch/generator) on another level waits out the idle cooldown; add flick designations to the work-version bump (instant probe re-arm — mechanism already exists, just notify on flick designation add).

## P2 — NEEDS COMPLETENESS (same shape as existing NeedsCross bridges)
10. **Scheduled drugs**: JobGiver_TakeScheduledDrugs searches pawn.Map only → doses skipped when drugs are stored elsewhere. Bridge like food (virtual FindDrugFor probe + hop) or ferry via demand registry (policy counts as consumable need).
11. **Patient self-bedding**: JobGiver_PatientGoToBed / RestUtility.FindPatientBedFor is map-scoped — ambulatory sick pawn should walk to the hospital level (owned-bed hop exists; hospital-bed variant missing).
12. **Deathrest (Biotech)**: deathrest caskets are buildings, not beds — audit whether a sanguophage routes to a casket on another level; bridge if not.

## P3 — DLC DOER GAPS (each is a scoped audit + small bridge if broken)
13. **Anomaly entity transport**: WorkGiver_TransportEntity is map-scoped — downed entity on surface, holding platform in basement never connects. Same shape as capture-across-levels (carry + arrival continuation). Study/suppress flows ride normal migration (verify only).
14. **Children learning (Biotech)**: JobGiver_Learn / school desks map-scoped — kids never descend to the classroom. Audit + bridge (needs-shaped).
15. **Throne/Reign (Royalty)**: JobGiver_Reign map-scoped — noble won't seek the throne room one level down. Audit + bridge.
16. **Mech repair/gestation (Biotech)**: repair giver + gestator bills should ride migration — verify only, bridge if the mechanitor-distance checks bite.
17. **Anima linking (Royalty)**: audit only (player-forced meditation near tree may already work via RMB parity).

## P4 — VERIFY-ONLY LIST (believed covered by migration/ferry; test, do not build unless red)
18. Crafter bench pull (cook idles up top, stove + ingredients below) — better-work probe should fire. 19. Research bench. 20. Refuel doer. 21. Warden recruit/convert/suppress. 22. Corpse→grave/sarcophagus ferry (container storage verified push-side). 23. Snow clearing. 24. Taming/training/milking/shearing on other levels. 25. Plant work + blight. 26. Repair/deconstruct/smooth. 27. Prisoner escape routing across levels (hostile-move owns it).

## OPEN QUESTIONS / OPTIONAL FEATURES (user to arbitrate)
- Animal area-driven migration (tamed non-master animals walking to an allowed area on another level) — design question from bug wave, still open.
- Guard-trip LETTER instead of transient message (three silent-failure reports argue for it).
- Cross-level "take to specific storage" for bills (list linked levels' groups with level suffix + route via demand).
- Level-aware storage-group NAMES (suffix "(surface)/(basement)" to defuse the per-map "group 1" collision confusion).

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky + basement (starter stairs) · AB: basement diagnostic · AB: light diagnostic · AB: RMB diagnostic.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE
0. Round-2 ferry verification (crafter continuation, merge-case arrivals, no stair-top piles, mech arrivals).
1. Below-level lighting from the sky view. 2. Animal flow + direct-to-blueprint. 3. BAM/Batch B/Batch C compat. 4. Perf-mod smoke, CE-absent run, translation audit, soak, publishing prep.
5. NEW: P4 verify-only sweep (one session: bench pull, research, refuel, warden, graves).

## FEATURE LEDGER
RMB 1:1 (VERIFIED, mech-inclusive) · basement (VERIFIED) · haul/ferry stack (ledger+clamps+onward+merge-safe+bill continuation) · below-level lighting · animal flows · mech charge (VERIFIED) · demand fixes · BAM compat · perf pass · Batch A verified · Batch B/C pending · PARITY SCAFFOLD P0-P4 defined (pass 26). REMOVED: skylights, mountain rivers.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE · Biomes! Caverns · Alpha Biomes · BM+MO · Odyssey+VLE · Misc. Robots/++ · Hauler's Dream+PUAH · Allow Tool · Ancient urban ruins · CE · Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF · Trader Airships, Hospitality · BAM · PO/Dubs Analyzer/TPT · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded · WVC: virtual-dispatch safe.

## Status
2026-07-25 (26th pass): **vanilla-parity deep scan complete — P0-P4 scaffold defined; P0 targets pinned to exact vanilla symbols (ITab_Bills / HealthCardUtility / building-existence alerts / fire visibility).** Awaiting user's pick of starting tier. Round-2 ferry fixes still pending in-game verification.
